messages:
anita: heads-up — night canary is spiking GPU thermal events on rtx-pool-3 after the quant-kernel v12 swap. if it keeps up we'll pin/rollback.
lee: seeing the same in telemetry. 95th latency is fine but temps hit 88C on a small subset (p-t2 hosts).
jun: can we pin the old kernel variant (abi v5 + quant q7) for the night bucket via deploy-bot? want to stop new traffic to the v12 variant asap.
deploy-bot: @anita request acknowledged. to pin run: `/deploy pin --pool rtx-pool-3 --image kernel:v11-abi5-quantq7 --ttl 6h`
anita: running that now...
anita: pasted output:
```\ndeploybot: pin accepted -> rtx-pool-3 pinned to kernel:v11-abi5-quantq7 until 2026-03-21T06:30:00Z\n```
michael: should we also pause the staged rollout to dedicated pools in eu-west? release notes still list kernel:v12 as default and customers might get surprised.
pm-elena: i can patch the product changelog but need the exact build/hash that was pushed so i can reference it.
lee: build hash is `c3a9f4d` for v12 quant. note: there's a sibling published tag `c3a9f4d+opt` that looks like an accidental orphaned variant — could explain different thermal behavior.
jun: good catch. rollback plan criteria if pin doesn't stop it: >1% GPU OOMs OR >3 distinct hosts with thermal > 90C sustained in 30m. that's our threshold to trigger full rollback.
anita: setting alert now: `thermal-alert:gpu-temp > 90C for 10m` and paging if seen on >=3 hosts.
ops-incidents-bot: Alert created: thermal-alert / threshold 90C / watchlist rtx-pool-3
anita: also note we have a gap in release notes — need a short ops blurb and a postmortem seed. i'll draft and tag infra owners.
pm-elena: thanks — include rollback command snippet: `/deploy rollback --image kernel:v11-abi5-quantq7 --pools rtx-pool-*` and mention pinned TTL in the note.
lee: suggestion: run a rebuild of v12 with CPU/GPU frequency scaling disabled (governor conservative) to rule out frequency governor induced thermal jumps before re-promoting.
michael: can we schedule a quiet-window re-run tomorrow 02:00 UTC to validate the v12+opt variant on a single host? prefer low-traffic validation.
jun: scheduled calendar event: runtime-thermal-retest 2026-03-21 02:00 UTC. attendees: jun, lee, anita, eng-oncall.
anita: after pin TTL expires i'll either unpin (if telemetry clean) or extend pin and escalate rollback. will post telemetry screenshots and the short release note draft here. :white_check_mark:
michael: thanks all — tidy up any stray `+opt` tags from the registry once we have a fix so we don't accidentally re-deploy the orphaned variant.
lee: ack — will coordinate with packaging to remove the `c3a9f4d+opt` tag and re-run packaging validations.
anita: marking thread as active until we clear alarms. ping me if you see new thermal hosts.
